Resource-Constrained Job Shop with Provisioner.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Resource_Provisioner, General_Hospital_Triage

payload.content: Iteration 1 ops plan (Resource_Provisioner): Checked latest inventory snapshot — GH has IV_Kits=20, PPE_Sets=21; St_Marys has IV_Kits=20, PPE_Sets=21. Both hospitals are already well above the safe buffers (IV>=6, PPE>=8), so NO bottleneck top-ups are needed this phase — sending more would only create holding cost (-10/unit) with zero failure risk reduction. No active resource failures reported. Plan: hold stock centrally, monitor queues/failures, and top up immediately only if a hospital's IV_Kits or PPE_Sets drops below safe buffers or a failure is observed. Non-bottleneck top-ups only on explicit request or shortage (<2).

GH_Triage iter 1 plan: Job queue has all 8 patients (step 0, 1h each). Inventory snapshot is safe: IV_Kits=20, PPE_Sets=21, well above buffers — no top-up needed, no transfers (nothing is short). I will NOT broadcast any surplus/deficit on public channels this phase (buffers comfortable, avoids holding-cost noise). Plan: schedule all 8 triage step-0 jobs at earliest feasible slots, spread across our capacity of 4, respecting each patient's earliest start (8,8,9,16,19,21,23,24). RP: please keep holding stock centrally per your plan; I'll ping you immediately if any failure or drop below IV<6 / PPE<8 shows up. No poaching needed — queue is full.
